candidates.change_summary: Replace the require condition with a failing condition that prevents depositsCount increment when depositsCount is nonzero (changes observable post-receive state).
Remove the require check so depositsCount always increments regardless of overflow concerns (changes observable post-receive state when wrapping would occur).
Replace the increment with a decrement so depositsCount decreases when receiving funds (observable difference).
Insert an extra increment so depositsCount increases by 2 on each receive call (observable difference).
Change the require to revert unconditionally, preventing any increment so depositsCount never changes (observable difference).
Removed the onlyOwner guard from withdrawAll so anyone can call it, changing who can trigger balance withdrawal and thus observable behavior.
Reversed the owner check in onlyOwner to require msg.sender != owner, allowing non-owners to call withdrawAll which alters observable post-withdrawal state.
Replace the transfer to call with empty data, which forwards all gas and returns success boolean instead of using transfer (can change reversion behavior and thus observed balance after withdraw).
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdraw so any caller can withdraw funds, changing which accounts can observe a different balance after withdraw.

Tighten onlyOwner to require msg.sender equals a zero address instead of the stored owner, effectively preventing normal owner from calling withdraw and thus altering observable withdraw behavior (reverts when owner calls).

Change the external call in sendMoney from an unchecked low-level call to a call whose return value is checked and reverts on failure (which can prevent or revert state changes in the callee and affect observable behavior).
Change the external call to use transfer instead of low-level call, which limits gas forwarded and will revert on failure, altering observable effects when interacting with contracts.
Remove the call entirely so sendMoney does nothing (no value sent), affecting the contract's observable balance and behavior.
Modify onlyOwner modifier to check the tx.origin instead of msg.sender, changing which callers are authorized and thus altering whether sendMoney can be executed.
